report.markdown:
# Birthplace and Proposal Year of the Inventor of the World Wide Web

## Birthplace and Proposal

Tim Berners-Lee was born in London, England on June 8, 1955. [1][2] One source reports that he wrote the first proposal for the World Wide Web in March 1989. [3] One source also reports that he first proposed his idea to his CERN supervisor, Mike Sendall, in March 1989. [4]

## Sources

1. [Tim Berners-Lee - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Berners-Lee) — wikipedia.org, published 2001-05-15, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [https://medium.com/@vidul1114/tim-berners-lee-bb7bd2f2dd6e](https://medium.com/@vidul1114/tim-berners-lee-bb7bd2f2dd6e) — medium.com, fetched 2026-10-31
3. [A short history of the Web – Home | CERN](https://home.cern/science/computing/the-birth-of-the-web/short-history-web) — home.cern, fetched 2026-10-31
4. [On August 6, 1991, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/technology/world-wide-web-introduced) — popsci.com, published 2024-08-06, fetched 2026-10-31
